meta.title: Design system
meta.description: Tokens, components & UI patterns of Relevé Dance Supply.

hero.title: The Relevé visual language
hero.tagline: Every step begins with the right shoe.
hero.intro: Monochrome, precise and calm — the product takes the stage. This page shows every token, component and pattern used by the store, with all states and sample data from the catalogue.

foundations.title: Foundations
foundations.description: Colour, type, spacing, radius and icons. Components use these tokens only.

primitives.title: Primitives
primitives.description: Building blocks in src/components/ui — keyboard accessible, touch targets ≥ 44px, always-visible focus.

store.title: Store components
store.description: Presentational components in src/components/store: product card, variant picker, cart, filters, size guide.

checkout.title: Checkout components
checkout.description: One-page, three-step checkout and the pay page — QRIS, Virtual Account, e-wallet, card. Digital payments only.

patterns.title: Patterns
patterns.description: How components work together: stock states, price, WhatsApp in every context and the pay page per method.

colors.title: Colour
colors.description: White background, ink text, Ballet Pink used sparingly. The number in the corner is the WCAG contrast ratio.
colors.rule: Rules: at most one primary (ink) button per screen/section · prices are always ink · WhatsApp green only for WhatsApp elements · ink-subtle is never body text.

usage.accent: Ballet Pink: New badge, hero tint
usage.warning: Only N left, pre-order, countdown < 5 min

type.title: Typography
type.description: Plus Jakarta Sans for UI, Cormorant Garamond only for taglines & quotes. Inputs are always ≥ 16px.
type.sampleBody: A soft stretch-canvas split-sole ballet flat that follows the arch and stays comfortable through long classes.
type.sampleCaption: Relevé Dance Supply is an independent store.

spacing.title: Spacing
spacing.description: Multiples of 4. Section rhythm 48px mobile, 80px desktop.

radius.title: Radius & shadow
radius.shadow: Shadows only on overlays (drawer, modal, popover). Cards use a border line.

icons.title: Icons & logos
icons.description: lucide, stroke 1.5, 20px (24px in nav). The WhatsApp glyph is reserved for WhatsApp actions.
icons.logosNote: Neutral text tiles stand in for brand logos in the demo; muted when not selected. Swap for official SVGs once usage rights exist.

button.description: 48px tall (sm 36px), 14px UPPERCASE label. Focus: 2px ink ring, offset 2.

link.sentence: Not sure about sizing? Open the

inputs.title: Inputs, Select & Combobox
inputs.description: 48px tall, label above, helper/error below. Combobox for the 119 regencies/cities of Java.
inputs.name: Full name
inputs.waHelp: Order confirmation & updates go to this number

choice.title: Checkbox, Radio & RadioCard
choice.terms: I agree to the terms & conditions

labels.title: Badge, Chip, Segmented & Tabs
labels.description: Small UPPERCASE status labels; pill chips for filters; segmented for width/shank.
labels.tabDescBody: Satin, medium box, standard vamp — suits Egyptian & Greek feet.
labels.tabFitBody: Go 1–2 sizes below your street size. Ask us on WhatsApp first.
labels.tabCareBody: Air out after class; do not wash.

disclosure.title: Accordion & overlays
disclosure.description: Radix: focus trapped, Esc closes. Dialogs on desktop become bottom sheets on mobile.
disclosure.body1: Leather ballet flat with suede split sole and a drawstring for adjustment.
disclosure.body2: Ships from Jakarta. Instant & same-day within Jabodetabek; all of Java via JNE, J&T, SiCepat.
disclosure.body3: QRIS, e-wallets (GoPay, OVO, DANA, ShopeePay), Virtual Account and credit/debit cards.
disclosure.dialogDesc: Claudia Satin · Ballet Pink · 6L · C · Full Normal
disclosure.dialogBody: Stock isn't reserved until you pay.
disclosure.sheetBody: The responsive variant powers SizeGuide and FilterSheet.
disclosure.drawerBody: Right 420px on desktop, bottom on mobile — used by CartDrawer.
disclosure.shankExplain: The stiff insole of a pointe shoe that supports the arch.

feedback.title: Feedback & navigation
feedback.description: Inline notices, skeletons (pulse off under reduced motion), breadcrumb, copy, load more.
feedback.pointeBody: Ask us on WhatsApp before you buy.
feedback.qtyReduced: Claudia Satin quantity reduced from 3 to 2 because stock changed.
feedback.stockBody: Not enough stock for Jive III (Black · 7L). We've updated your cart.

identity.title: Identity & page shell
identity.description: Our own wordmark (never the Só Dança logo), sticky header, surface-alt footer with the independent-store disclaimer.

product.title: Product
product.description: 1:1 cards without an add button — size must be chosen on the PDP. Aggregate stock badge, max 5 swatches + N.

picker.description: Colour → Size → Width → Shank per product.options. Non-existent combos are disabled; sold-out ones are struck through but still selectable for “Notify me”. Try pressing the button without a size.

cart.title: Cart
cart.description: CartLine with 44px stepper; CartDrawer shows stock and mixed pre-order notices.
cart.notice: Farfalla quantity was reduced to 2 because stock changed.
cart.emptyBody: Try removing some filters, or ask us — we'll help you find it.

filter.title: Filters & comparison
filter.description: Desktop: 240px sidebar. Mobile: bottom sheet with an accordion per facet + “Show n products”.

sizeGuide.description: Tabs per category, US ↔ foot length (cm) table, how to measure, pointe callout and WhatsApp consultation. Table values are approximate (Q-06).

flow.title: Checkout flow
flow.description: One page, three steps. Completed steps show a summary + “Edit”; upcoming ones are locked.
flow.name: Recipient name

pay.title: Pay page
pay.description: Panels per method, Countdown (warning < 5 minutes, expired → new payment), payment status and demo controls.

stock.title: Honest stock — 4 states
stock.description: Ready · Only N left · Pre-order · Sold out, consistent on cards, PDP and size chips. Sold out → the CTA becomes “Notify Me on WhatsApp”.

price.title: Price
price.description: Always formatIDR (Rp 1.250.000), tabular-nums, ink — never red or accent.

wa.title: WhatsApp in every context
wa.description: One tap from anywhere. wa.me links are built by WS-2's builder (src/lib/wa) with context-specific text.
wa.fab: FAB (all store pages except checkout & pay)
wa.rule: WhatsApp green is only for WhatsApp elements; text on it is always whatsapp-ink (white fails contrast).

pay.title: Pay page × state
pay.description: QRIS / Virtual Account / e-wallet / card, each waiting · paid · expired.

footer.note: Design system demo — all sample data. Relevé Dance Supply is an independent store and is not affiliated with Só Dança.
